import os,sys,tempfile,shutil,subprocess,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
files=['analysis/correlation.py','analysis/finding_engine.py','scanner/sast/common.py','scanner/sast/evidence.py','scanner/sast/html_scanner.py','scanner/sast/security_context.py','scanner/sast/secret_scanner.py','scanner/header_scanner.py','scanner/xss_scanner.py','scanner/sqli_scanner.py','scanner/disclosure_scanner.py','scanner/directory_scanner.py']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='phase16-original-') as td:
 overlay=Path(td)/'code';overlay.mkdir()
 for package in ('scanner','analysis'):
  shutil.copytree(root/package,overlay/package,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__'))
 # Only Phase16-modified files revert in this disposable import overlay; all
 # other code (including approved Phase13 identity fixes) stays current.
 for file in files:
  (overlay/file).write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+file],cwd=root))
 for mode in ('BEFORE','AFTER'):
  env=os.environ.copy();env['SENTINELSCAN_DATA_DIR']=str(Path(td)/('data-'+mode));env['SENTINELSCAN_LLM_ENABLED']='false';env.pop('SENTINELSCAN_GITHUB_TOKEN',None)
  env['PYTHONPATH']=os.pathsep.join(([str(overlay)] if mode=='BEFORE' else [])+[str(root)])
  r=subprocess.run([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-B','/tmp/phase16_repro.py'],env=env,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
  if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
  (root/('docs/fixes/PHASE_16_REPRO_'+mode+'.json')).write_text(r.stdout)
  print(mode,{k:v['count'] for k,v in json.loads(r.stdout).items()})
